basis: PIM test gate checklist for converged cellular + ERCES plates (grade E planning artifact): IM3 screen hits plus the field procedure. PIM limits are project inputs; the practice defaults cited come from IEC 62037-style field testing.

checklist.item: CONVERGED PLATE: the IM3 screen found 2 products landing in the PS passbands (2xN71_600-B5_850=387.5 MHz -> UHF; 2xB66_2100-N77_CBAND=450.0 MHz -> UHF). The channel-specific PS filters MUST be order lines (owner direction 2026-11-26).

PIM test every shared trunk and tap plate before the cellular carrier activation with 2x43 dBm tones; pass is at or below -100 dBm IM3 unless the project spec says otherwise (IEC 62037 field practice: values are band  dependent).
checklist.source: AHJ trigger: intermod studies required when other systems share the building (DC OUC 2.2.3); PIM testing may be required on the results

checklist.item: PIM test the donor antenna, its jumpers and connectors, and the BDA/head-end ports; donor-side PIM is the loudest path into the PS receive window.
On a failing line: half-split the trunk (the divide-and-conquer tap isolation), test each half, and repeat to the section; standard PIM hunting practice.

PIM-rated jumpers and connectors only on shared lines; torque to the connector spec, no dissimilar metals, no ferrous hardware near the 700/800 lines; re-torque after any flex. The residential-ceiling congestion and PIM note in the MCF design spec applies.
Re-run the ERCES coverage check (grid cells) for 700/800/VHF/UHF as ordered with the cellular carriers active; verify the PS SINR does not collapse at the instrument and record the before/after.
checklist.source: the converged-plate risk: cellular activation can raise the noise and PIM into the PS receive path

checklist.item: Record tone level, IM3 limit, per-line results, and the corrective actions in the acceptance package; re-test fails after the fixes and before the AHJ witness.
